faqs.question: Do I need to ventilate the room where the printer is installed?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Air should vent out of the room and fresh air should come into the room. Air should             not circulate in the room. The UV UltraChrome ink smell can cause discomfort and             possibly dizziness.
Note:
The SureColor V7000 must be placed in a room whose ventilation system is capable of 3             to 5 ACH (air changes per hour). If the existing ventilation system is inadequate, an             additional system may be required.

faqs.question: What are the power specifications to use the printer?
faqs.answer:
Rated frequency
: 50/60 Hz
Printer
: Single-phase 200-240V AC, 50/60Hz, 30A
Breaker
: 40A (50A recommended)
Power line (breaker to printer)
: 3 lines (lead, neutral, PE)
Printer terminal
: O-type (clamped on)
Note:
A certified electrician is required to connect the power cable to the printer (the             cable will be provided by the electrician). A separate connection is needed to connect             the power from the computer to the printer.

faqs.question: What is the maximum paper size and thickness I can use in the printer?
faqs.answer: The maximum size is 49.2 inches x 98.4 inches. The maximum thickness is 3.15 inches.

faqs.question: What is needed to set up the printer?
faqs.answer:
Epson will contact you to verify if your environment meets the requirements to set                 up the printer. The following will be discussed:
Delivery requirements, for example, are available for the following: loading                         dock, forklift, riggers.
Printer operation area
Power requirements
Schedule a date to set-up the printer
Epson will send personnel to install the printer on-site. The installation will take                 approximately 2 days; this includes a ½ day to unpack and 1½ days to set up the                     printer.
Note:
A certified electrician is needed on-site the first day to connect                     the power to the printer.
Epson will provide personnel for training printer operators. Only trained operators                 can operate the printer. Training will take approximately 2 days and the operators                 must be available for the full 2 days of training.

faqs.question: How do I cure the ink?
faqs.answer: The printer will cure the UV ink with an LED light. Coolant is used to cool the lighting             elements. The operator should wear UV protective goggles during prolonged exposure to             LED lights. The operator should also wear a long sleeve shirt and gloves.

faqs.question: Can I use a third-party ink with the Epson UV ink?
faqs.answer: Epson does not recommend using third-party ink with Epson UltraChrome UV ink. Combining             the inks can possibly damage the ink lines and/or print heads. Use only Epson             UltraChrome UV ink with the printer.

faqs.question: Does the printer operator need to wear safety equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Since the UV ink used to print is chemical ink and can cause skin irritation and             discomfort, the operator should wear the following:
Gloves (Polyethylene gloves, with an inner nylon glove and an outer latex glove, are                 highly recommended.)
Goggles, safety glasses, or a face shield
A long sleeve shirt (a solvent-resistant apron is also recommended.)
A mask

faqs.question: What are the computer system requirements to set up the printer?
faqs.answer:
Two Microsoft Windows-compatible PCs with an Intel i7 or better multicore processor                 (One for the UV printer controller software, and the other for the Epson Edge Print                 software.)
Microsoft Windows 10 64-bit
At least 8 GB RAM
500 GB SSD
HD widescreen monitor
USB 3.0 or Ethernet 1000Base-T port (the respective cable will also be needed)

faqs.question: How many ink colors does the printer use and what size are the bottles?
faqs.answer: The printer uses 10 colors: Cyan, Light Cyan, Magenta, Light Magenta, Yellow, Red, Grey,             Black, White, and Varnish. The ink bottles are 1 liter.

faqs.question: What is the minimum space I need to place and operate the printer?
faqs.answer: 16.7 feet x 21.4 feet of floor space is needed. The printer size is 168 (W)  inches x 82             (D) inches. A 5-foot area is needed in front and behind the printer and a 3-foot area is             needed on both sides of the printer.
